svg.title: From a wrapped book to a contextual HBO Max clue
svg.desc: Two aligned sequences compare a blind date with a book at Strand with the Surprise Rail interaction in HBO Max.
svg.text: A familiar mechanic, translated to HBO Max.
At Strand, the missing cover made the clues do the work. I kept that tension and changed the format.
The clue creates a reason to keep going.
The familiar HBO Max tile carries the interaction.
